notes: Read the complete unit, preceding diagnosis, all twelve candidates and the review. Restored ongoing party-building and completed program-writing as factual actions with policy content. Resolved the U.S. society, constitution and republic scope and identified DSA program demands, the current capitalist system and complete victory. Restored the common-good condition, the guiding-goal characterization and the necessity of working-class organization.

claims.claim_text: The envisioned classless, egalitarian world is the DSA movement's guiding goal.
Laboring for the common good rather than private profit could enable secure, dignified lives and freedom to use one's time and talents.
Achieving that future requires the working class to organize.
DSA is building a party aimed at a democratic working-class society.
DSA identifies the entire anti-democratic structure of U.S. society, not only individual officials, as its enemy.
DSA workers are fighting to draft a new U.S. constitution.
DSA workers are fighting to create a U.S. democratic socialist republic.
DSA has written this program to end capitalist oligarchy and create real democracy.
Some DSA program demands may be won under the current capitalist system.
Complete victory for the DSA program is said to require building a new society.
DSA presses its program demands as far as possible now to pursue their fullest realization in a socialist future.
